high_risk_rechecks.finding: Current DailyMed 12.1 identifies sotatercept-csrk as an ActRIIA-Fc fusion protein binding activin A and other TGF-beta-superfamily ligands, improving the balance between ActRIIA/Smad2/3 and BMPRII/Smad1/5/8 signaling.
Current QALSODY 12.1 states that tofersen binds SOD1 mRNA and causes its degradation, reducing SOD1 protein synthesis.
Current SKYCLARYS 12.1 documents Nrf2-pathway activation while explicitly stating that the precise therapeutic mechanism in Friedreich ataxia is unknown; the item preserves that evidence boundary.
The candidate tests CRISPR/Cas9 editing of the erythroid-specific BCL11A enhancer/GATA1-binding site rather than beta-globin gene replacement; no structural beta-globin repair is asserted.
Current LIVDELZI 12.1 identifies seladelpar as a PPAR-delta agonist and states that its therapeutic mechanism in PBC is not well understood; the item does not overstate causality.
Current DUVYZAT 12.1 identifies givinostat as a histone deacetylase inhibitor and states that the precise therapeutic mechanism in DMD is unknown; the item is limited to enzyme-class identification.
Current PAXLOVID labeling separates nirmatrelvir's SARS-CoV-2 Mpro inhibition from ritonavir's CYP3A-mediated pharmacokinetic boosting; ritonavir is not active against SARS-CoV-2 Mpro.
Current JOURNAVX 12.1 identifies suzetrigine as a selective NaV1.8 voltage-gated sodium-channel blocker in peripheral sensory neurons.
